headline: Oricon Enterprises: SEBI Takeover Regulation Disclosure by Suhrid Somani
sum: Suhrid Somani has filed a disclosure under SEBI Regulation 31(4) regarding a substantial acquisition of shares in Oricon Enterprises Limited, submitted to NSE on 22 June 2026.
implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosure triggers mandatory public announcements and potential Open Offer obligations if the acquirer has breached the 25% threshold; practitioners must verify the current holding level and any resultant offer trigger.
detail: Suhrid Somani submitted a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 to the NSE. This regulation requires disclosure whenever a person acquires shares crossing specified thresholds (typically 25%, 50%, etc.). The filing is accessible via the NSE corporate archives. The precise acquisition size, consideration, conditions, and whether an open offer is mandated remain to be clarified from the full disclosure document and any subsequent company announcements.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 - Regulation 31(4)
framework.note: Mandatory disclosure requirement when acquirer crosses specified shareholding thresholds; triggers public announcement and potential open offer obligations.
Definition of 'acquirer', 'person acting in concert', and triggering events for substantial acquisition; scope of exemptions.
Public announcement requirement and timing; disclosure of offer price, shares offered, and conditions.
Open offer mechanics: minimum 90% of voting shares if crossing 25% or higher threshold.
Director appointment and disclosure; identification of key persons in the acquirer entity.
Exemptions from mandatory open offer (e.g., voluntary acquisition, purchase from open market).
